claim: The manager role reports $0 cost across every single run in the corpus, regardless of which model is configured.

support.interpretation: Manager runs as a persistent long-lived agent that handles tool dispatch. Its API spend is most likely being attributed to whichever sub-agent it called, via cache reads, rather than to the manager role itself.

scope: Cost accounting only. Does NOT mean the manager's choice of model is free in reality.
limitations: Have not cross-referenced against raw Anthropic API logs to confirm whether the manager's actual API spend is really zero or just misattributed.
If it is misattributed, then any 'use cheaper manager' optimization will appear to save zero in stats but might save real money.
confidence: high (for the accounting fact); low (for any inferred behavior)
policy_recommendation: Until verified against API logs, treat manager model as a free knob — choose it for routing-quality (the manager's reasoning matters), not for cost.
